segments.title: Birth, family and beginning trumpet with New Orleans teachers
segments.summary: Bentley gives his birth year (1924), says no parents played music, started trumpet at about 14, and names teachers born in New Orleans.

segments.title: Playing with the Claiborne and George Williams band and Nat Towles
segments.summary: He names George Williams's band, the old Claiborne Williams band taken over by his son, and Nat Towles's band in the Middle West; he has been with the Gibson band about a month.

segments.title: Dance halls and small combos rather than brass bands
segments.summary: He has no daytime job, never played brass bands before, and played dance halls and French Quarter clubs with small bands of four to six pieces.

segments.title: Brass band versus dance orchestra music
segments.summary: He finds the brass band alright but says dance orchestra music is smoother.

segments.title: Earlier records with Nat Towles's orchestra
segments.summary: He made records some years ago with Nat Towles but cannot recall the label or year.

segments.title: Arranging and end of interview
segments.summary: He has done some short arranging; the rest is ASR junk of repeated 'The End'.
